entries.uncertainty: This is a known-figure nominal subtotal only. Pico's own onboard VBUS/VSYS bulk capacitance is not established from its datasheet text, and effective (not nominal) capacitance, fitted-part tolerance, source impedance and attach waveform are all unqualified. This subtotal is not a measured or claimed inrush-compliance result; overall inrush status stays unknown and G07 stays OPEN.

entries.claim: CAT1 (5-pin regulator) output feeds LED-A; the three LED cathode returns each go to GND through R17/R18/R19 (~2 ohm each), not three resistors feeding LED-A directly from VSYS
entries.citation: design/evidence/g01-display-power.md, "Current and inrush figures for G07" (Sch p1 3A "LCD BACKLIGHT", 4A-C "LCD")
entries.uncertainty: Topology (regulator + cathode-return resistors) is read from the schematic image and treated as verified. The regulator's identity, output voltage and hence backlight current are not printed and remain unknown (see backlight-regulator-identity).

entries.claim: CAT1's exact part number and output voltage
entries.uncertainty: Not printed on the schematic; backlight current cannot be derived without it. Requires the physical module or a higher-resolution schematic render.

entries.claim: CAT1 EN (pin 3, the LCD_BL node) logic thresholds V_IH / V_IL and EN input current
entries.citation: design/evidence/backlight-interface.md, "What the table does not establish"; Waveshare schematic p1 LCD BACKLIGHT (3A) shows CAT1 pins VIN/GND/EN/BYP/VOUT and R16 10K VSYS->LCD_BL/EN only, no part number (PDF text extraction and 300 dpi render, 2026-09-26)
entries.uncertainty: Without the regulator identity the thresholds cannot be cited. The #41 open-drain interface does not depend on them: off relies on LCD_BL being held within a few millivolts of GND by Q1, on relies on the module's own R16 pull-up to VSYS (the vendor's stacked arrangement). Read CAT1's marking on the received module and record the datasheet thresholds at G01.

entries.claim: "5V 180mA" as a manufacturer-stated module maximum current
entries.citation: design/evidence/g01-display-power.md, "Current and inrush figures for G07"; scripts/power_budget.py waveshare_current_check_note
entries.uncertainty: The only prior support for this figure was an automated fetch summary describing an FAQ image on the Waveshare wiki. Both FAQ images at that URL were downloaded and visually inspected and show unrelated file-browser screenshots, not a power spec; no textual mA/current figure was found on either wiki page. Rejected rather than reported as unknown, since the specific claim was checked and not supported. Not used in any budget calculation.
